column1: # Problem-misbinding mutations for the Stage-0 spike.
# Each row defines a logical mutation of an expected-UNSAT fixture. The proof of
# the unmutated fixture is preserved and re-checked against the mutated problem.
# The Stage-0 equivalent of a K_ref/P_ref hash mismatch is exactly this: the
# proof is internally fine, but it is a proof about a different logical problem.
# Every mutation below turns the fixture from UNSAT into SAT, i.e. it destroys
# the property the preserved proof claims to establish. Any checker that still
# accepts the old proof against the mutated problem has not bound the proof to
# count: 0 = replace every occurrence, N = replace the first N occurrences
